definition: the drop my tracked weeks show at the end of July, and whether it is a slide or a step

settled:
These figures were measured off my session tracking and read back to me, so they are a reading of the record rather than something I said.

A straight line through the eight weeks slopes down about 0.11 levels a week, one full level in nine or ten weeks. That slope does not survive dropping the final week. The six weeks through 30 July are flat and the whole slope is carried by the last seven days, which average 2.81 against 3.53 for the thirty-one days before them.

A single step down at 31 July fits better than a gradual decline, and 31 July is about when the new arrangement started.

My own answer to that: "Yeah, that tracks. The last week is the phase shift where both the sleep and dates kicked in. I'll need more weeks to know what the post-trip trend looks like."

So I place the step on the arrangement starting. Whether that is the price of starting or the beginning of a slide is not answerable from eight weeks.
